                                                                                                      business school. (2) Minimum of 10 years of full time

                                                                                                      Currently admitted to UNLV's Boyd School of Law,

                                                                                                      Medicine. (4) Provide official documentation of
                                                                                                      expired GMAT or GRE scores that meet or exceed
                                                                                                      our recommended score requirement, along with 5
                                                                                                      years of work experience.
